What are your bonus expectations?*
Account for any lapse of time not covered in your employment or education record?*
Are you at least 18 years old?*

Are you able to work for any employer in the United States?*
Do you now, or will you in the future, require sponsorship?*
Have you ever been terminated, asked to resign, or left a job without notice?*
Have you ever been de-barred, suspended, or subject to limited denial of participation by HUD?*

Have any business or professional license ever held by you ever been revoked, suspended, surrendered, subject to disciplinary proceedings, or in any way restricted by probation or agreement by ANY licensing authority in ANY state?*

Are you the subject of a Freddie Mac No New Business Letter that is still in effect, or have you received any similar notification from any other lender or secondary market mortgage participant?*

Do you have a financial interest or affiliation with a competitor or potential competitor of Greystone? Financial interests include ownership interests, partnerships, investments, etc. Affiliations include serving as an officer, director, board member, committee member, or employee.*
Do you have financial interests or affiliations with a service provider or potential service provider to Greystone? Service providers include suppliers and vendors.*
Do you have a financial interest or affiliation with any client or potential client of Greystone? Clients include borrowers, sponsors, principals, and properties.*

Do you have an immediate family member or close friend who is an employee, officer, director, or partner of any client, competitor, potential competitor, service provider or potential service provider?*
Do you have any existing business arrangements with Greystone or an affiliate of Greystone, e.g. participating in a joint venture, partnership, or other arrangement?*
